harness: Claude Code with kmaudit's APM package installed (the skills, the kmaudit-claims-extractor agent and the kmaudit MCP server) and mcp__kmaudit__* allowed; eval 4 runs where no agent exists

evals.name: fixture-first-pass
evals.repo: tests/fixtures/audit_repo.py's repository plus .okf/decisions/0005-audits-report-only.md (11 sections in 3 concepts)
evals.expected_output: Every pending section is stored by the kmaudit-claims-extractor agent through the claims_submit MCP tool; the main session reports the agent's summary and the counts from claims_todo and claims_list, and holds no claim text.
expectations: The main session calls claims_todo first and dispatches kmaudit-claims-extractor with the concept paths it lists
The agent stores every section through mcp__kmaudit__claims_submit and runs no shell command
claims_list shows claims for all three concepts
git status --porcelain is empty: nothing under .okf/ or docs/ changed
The main session's transcript holds the agent's summary but no claim text
Sentences about history, status and rejected options are kind none

evals.name: fixture-after-an-edit
evals.prompt: I just edited .okf/tool.md - refresh the claims
evals.repo: the repository of eval 1 after it ran, with one sentence of .okf/tool.md changed
evals.expected_output: Only the edited section is handed to the agent; the other ten stay as stored.
expectations: claims_todo lists only .okf/tool.md (1 section) before the agent runs
The agent is dispatched with that one file

evals.name: nothing-to-do
evals.prompt: are the bundle's claims up to date? extract any that aren't
evals.repo: the repository of eval 1 after it ran, unchanged
evals.expected_output: The skill sees 0 pending in claims_todo, dispatches no agent and shows the counts from claims_list.
expectations: The reply says the claims are up to date and shows the counts

evals.name: no-agent-harness
evals.repo: the repository of eval 1 before it ran, in a harness with the kmaudit MCP server and no kmaudit-claims-extractor agent (Antigravity or OpenCode)
evals.expected_output: The main session works through the batch itself with claims_todo and claims_submit, then reports the same summary and counts.
expectations: Every section is stored through the claims_submit MCP tool, with folder the repository root joined with the namespace
No kmaudit shell command is run
